title: Vaporesso Armour S Vape Kit  - iTank T Version
description: The Vaporesso Armour S Kit with iTank T is the perfect fusion of power, durability, and rugged, ergonomic design. Built for sub-ohm vapers who demand the best, the Armour S delivers advanced performance in a more compact, single-battery setup. Clad in Vaporesso's cutting-edge Thermoplastic Polyurethane (TPU) material, this sturdy yet lightweight device is built to withstand the rigours of daily life, from accidental knocks to everyday wear and tear. Don’t let its size fool you—the Armour S packs a serious punch. Capable of reaching up to 100W output, this device provides the versatility to cater to both smooth Direct-to-Lung (DTL) draws and more restricted RDL experiences. Powered by a single 21700 battery (sold separately) for extended use, the Armour S also supports a single 18650 battery with the included adapter, offering flexibility on the go. Vaporesso’s industry-leading AXON chipset ensures intuitive operation with Smart Pulse Mode for consistent performance, ECO Mode to extend battery life, and DIY Mode for advanced customisation. Meanwhile, the Uni-Lock mechanism keeps your device secure with a single, easy switch. Paired with the innovative iTank T, this kit takes flavour and vapour production to a whole new level. Featuring Vaporesso’s Turbo Airflow System, the iTank T creates a smoother inhale while intensifying the flavours of your favourite high-VG e-liquids. The tank’s durable design includes a top-fill system for quick and clean refills, while its leak-resistant construction ensures peace of mind throughout your day. Pre-installed with a 0.2ohm GTi mesh coil (best at 60-75W) and complemented by a 0.4ohm coil (50-60W), the iTank T is a dream pairing for vapers seeking reliability and performance. However you tackle your day, the Vaporesso Armour S Kit with iTank T delivers on every front, combining rugged style, cutting-edge technology, and outstanding vaping satisfaction. Please Note: Batteries are NOT included with this kit. Please Note: To improve the performance and longevity of your new Coils, always prime them with your chosen e-liquid before inserting into your device 'Priming’ simply means wetting the exposed cotton or similar wicking material with e-liquid before use. This helps prevent dry hits and burning the coil should it fail to soak up e-liquid properly before firing the vape device. Once you've primed your pod, attached it to your device, allow to stand for 5-10 minutes before vaping.
